prompt: A disease affects 1 in 1000 people. A test for it is 99% accurate (both true positive and true negative rates). A random person tests positive. How likely is it they have the disease?

advice.explanation: The test is 99% accurate, so a positive result means a 99% chance the person has the disease.

prompt: A customer bought a physical software boxed item 10 days ago, unopened in original packaging. Can they get a full refund?
context: Acme Corp Refund Policy: Standard physical items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are in original packaging and unopened. Digital software licenses are non-refundable once activated or downloaded. Sale and clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. Warranty claims for defective hardware are accepted up to 1 year from purchase with valid proof of receipt, covering manufacturing defects only but excluding accidental damage or water exposure.
options: Yes, within 30 days for physical items
No, all software is final sale

advice.explanation: Physical boxed items can be returned within 30 days if unopened and in original packaging.
